evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2003-007 - implementation of D.R. 114/2003
evidence.claim: In 2003, XRF lead screening for pigments was introduced due to the use of basic lead chromate CL-77 in AF-12 and regulation D.R. 114/2003.
evidence.quote: From 1/11/2003 every incoming pigment lot is screened for lead. Applies because AF-12 uses basic lead chromate CL-77.

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: The 2003 revision of QP-02 formally added XRF lead screening to comply with regulation D.R. 114/2003.
evidence.quote: XRF lead screening of every incoming pigment lot (D.R. 114/2003).

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: As of 2009, the XRF lead screening step remained in the QC release plan under regulation D.R. 114/2003.
evidence.quote: XRF lead screening of every incoming pigment lot (D.R. 114/2003).

evidence.title: Decreto Regionale n. 114/2003 - estratto
evidence.claim: Regulation D.R. 114/2003 required plants using lead pigments to verify the lead content of every incoming lot starting November 2003.
evidence.quote: devono verificare il contenuto di piombo di ogni lotto di pigmento in ingresso con un metodo analitico documentato

evidence.title: ARAPO - Decreto Regionale n. 52/2018
evidence.claim: In 2018, regulation D.R. 114/2003 was repealed and replaced by D.R. 52/2018, allowing reliance on supplier certificates if lead pigments are not used.
evidence.quote: Regional Decree 114/2003 is repealed. Art. 3 - Plants that do not use lead-containing pigments may rely on the supplier's certificate

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, the plant decided to remove all lead and chromate pigments from formulations by the end of the year due to customer and regional requirements.
evidence.quote: all lead and chromate pigments will be removed from our formulations by 31 December 2006

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, basic lead chromate CL-77 in AF-12 was replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40, with the last lead pigment delivery scheduled for October 2006.
evidence.quote: basic lead chromate CL-77 will be replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 from Fosfazinco Nord

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
evidence.claim: In 2007, ZP-40 was qualified as a lead-free replacement for AF-12, showing lead levels below 50 ppm.
evidence.quote: Material: zinc phosphate anti-corrosive pigment ZP-40, for AF-12. Results: zinc phosphate 98.5 %; free alkalinity not detectable (< 0.05 %); pH of 10 % slurry 6.9; oil absorption 28 g/100 g; lead < 50 ppm.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
evidence.claim: In 2007, ZP-40 was officially approved for use in AF-12 starting from recipe revision 11/12.
evidence.quote: Conclusion: ZP-40 approved for AF-12 from recipe Rev 11/12 (2007).

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: As of June 2021, the XRF lead screening step is no longer listed in the QP-02 Batch QC release plan.
evidence.quote:
QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
Document: QP-02 Batch QC release
Revision: Rev 6 (current), effective 07/06/2021.
